visual_action: A slideshow of still photographs celebrating Ketanji Brown Jackson's confirmation to the Supreme Court. The video shows her smiling in a black-and-white photo, taking a selfie with Joe Biden while her confirmation vote is displayed on a TV behind them, shaking hands with Kamala Harris, walking with both Biden and Harris on a red carpet, and shaking hands with Biden outdoors as Harris claps.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: She is the subject of every photograph and is named in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Appears in multiple photos celebrating with Ketanji Brown Jackson.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Appears in multiple photos celebrating with Ketanji Brown Jackson.

cast.name: Supreme Court
cast.evidence: Mentioned in the on-screen text: "...confirmed to the Supreme Court".

on_screen_text.text: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, the first Black woman confirmed to the Supreme Court 💜
U.S. SENATE...CONFIRM TO U.S. SUPREME COURT

spoken_summary: The video has no spoken words, only instrumental music.
audio_music: An upbeat, celebratory instrumental hip-hop/funk track plays throughout. According to music identification, the track begins with 'Say it feeling' by BerthCh and switches to 'Over You' by Richard andrea.
editing_pacing: A slideshow of still photos with quick cuts that transition on the beat of the music.
central_claim: The confirmation of Ketanji Brown Jackson as the first Black woman on the Supreme Court is a historic and celebratory achievement.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of pride and celebration for this historic appointment and to associate this success with the Biden-Harris administration.
